segments.text: That Gods creating of a new supernatural work of grace in the soul of any man, is that mans sure and infallible evidence of a saving interest in Jesus Christ.

You have heard why the regenerating work of the Spirit is called a new creation; in what respect every soul in Christ is renewed; what the eximious properties of this new creature are: the indispensibleness and necessity thereof hath been also proved: and how it evidences our interest in Christ was cleared in the doctrinal part, which we now come to improve in the several Uses serving
for our
1. Information.
2. Conviction.
3. Examination.
4. Exhortation.
5. Consolation.
